clauses.requirement: For the water spray test equipment (water spray cabinet) used in the moisture test, the rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm and shall rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.

For the water spray test equipment, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform; the collector height shall be 100 mm and its inside diameter shall be a minimum of 140 mm.

In the moisture test, which evaluates the ability of the sample device to resist moisture penetration from a water spray and determines drainage capability of devices with drain holes or other exposed openings, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to the water spray test procedure specified in the following sub-clauses.
During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the sample device shall remain open; drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.

If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated during the water spray test at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate) and 55 min OFF.
The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device shall be allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
